title: Why does independent evaluation matter for world models?
summary: The builder's own simulator should not be the only judge of the builder's system.
body: Developers should not be the sole judges of systems whose performance depends on interaction with a deployment environment. Independent evaluators and independently defined test conditions reduce dependence on vendor-selected simulations and reveal whether performance transfers beyond favourable conditions.
